api_token.description: The token to authenticate to Jerakia with. This can also be set with the `JERAKIA_TOKEN` environment variable.

api_url.description: The URL to the Jerakia service. This can also be set with the `JERAKIA_URL` environment variable.

found.description: A boolean which indicates whether a result was found.

key.description: The name of the Jerakia key to look up.

lookup_type.description: The type of lookup to perform. Valid values are `first` and `cascade`.

merge.description: The merge strategy to use for cascade lookups. Valid values are `array`, `hash`, and `deep_hash`.

metadata.description: A set of key/value pairs used by the default scope handler to set the query context.

policy.description: The policy to use for the query

result_json.description: The data returned from the query, as a JSON-encoded string.

scope.description: The name of an alternative scope handler to use.

scope_options.description: Options to pass to the scope handler.

status.description: The status of the query. An error will be returned if this is `failed`.

block.description: Data source for performing Jerakia lookups.
